info.name: MenuVista API Complete - Structured Role Collection
info.description:
MenuVista API collection organized by role and domain relationship.

Publish-ready notes added from handler/model/migration constraints.
Doc snapshot date: 2026-03-02.

Global Response Envelope:
- Success: { success: true, status_code, data, meta? }
- Error: { success: false, status_code, error, code }

Canonical enum/value references:
- role: admin, owner, staff, partner
- billing_cycle: monthly, annual
- provider: profile-driven (currently implemented verifiers: cbe, telebirr)
- payment_status: pending, succeeded, failed, refunded, completed
- discount_type: percentage, fixed_amount
- discount_applicable_to: all_items, specific_categories, specific_items
- verification_mode: manual, auto, both

Date/timestamp formats used across endpoints:
- Analytics start_date/end_date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Event start_date/end_date payload fields: YYYY-MM-DD
- Payment filter created_from/created_to: RFC3339

request.description:
Registers a new owner account. Public registration uses pending activation flow and optionally accepts marketer_referral_code for attribution.
Auth: Public endpoint. No authentication required unless stated otherwise.
Request Body Fields:
- email: Valid email address.
- password: Plain-text password. Registration/reset requires min length 8.
- full_name: Full display name.
- role: Role value. Allowed: owner.
- phone: Phone number string (E.164 recommended).
- marketer_referral_code: Optional partner referral code used to attribute the owner signup to a marketer.
- campaign: Optional attribution campaign label stored with owner-partner referral.
Response Contract:
- Success envelope: { success: true, status_code, data, meta? }
- Error envelope: { success: false, status_code, error, code }
- Common HTTP statuses: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 422 Unprocessable Entity, 500 Internal Server Error

- status: Status filter. Value set depends on entity (subscription/payment/invoice/restaurant).
- provider: Payment provider filter. Must match configured payment receiver profile provider.
- payment_method: Payment method filter/string (implementation-specific, e.g., bank_transfer, mobile_wallet).
- owner_id: Owner UUID filter.
- subscription_id: Subscription UUID filter.
- tref: Transaction reference contains filter (partial match).
- created_from: RFC3339 timestamp lower bound filter for created_at.
- created_to: RFC3339 timestamp upper bound filter for created_at.
- limit: Maximum records to return (integer). Default varies by endpoint (commonly 50 for payments, 10 for admin logs).
- offset: Pagination offset (integer, >=0). Default: 0.
